# VAXMetal

> VAXMetal is a contract manufacturing company in Ukraine supplying fabricated metal parts, welded assemblies, finished sub-systems and OEM products for European and international B2B customers.

VAXMetal combines metal fabrication, laser cutting, CNC machining, sheet-metal bending, welding, powder coating, assembly, quality control and export-ready packaging.

## Main site
- https://www.vaxmetal.com/en — Full-cycle contract manufacturing overview
- https://www.vaxmetal.com/en/industries — Industries and product directions
- https://www.vaxmetal.com/en/contact — Contact and RFQ

## Manufacturing services
- https://www.vaxmetal.com/en/services/custom-metal-fabrication — Custom metal fabrication from drawing, sketch, photo or requirement
- https://www.vaxmetal.com/en/services/contract-manufacturing-oem — Contract manufacturing for OEMs and integrators
- https://www.vaxmetal.com/en/services/laser-cutting — Laser cutting
- https://www.vaxmetal.com/en/services/sheet-metal-bending — Sheet metal and CNC bending
- https://www.vaxmetal.com/en/services/welding — Welding
- https://www.vaxmetal.com/en/services/powder-coating — Powder coating
- https://www.vaxmetal.com/en/services/assembly-qc — Assembly and quality control

## Industry capabilities
- https://www.vaxmetal.com/en/industries/anti-drone-protection — Physical anti-drone protection structures, netting supports, vehicle frames and protective steel structures for fixed assets
- https://www.vaxmetal.com/en/industries/electric-heaters — OEM electric heating panels, VAXTherm heaters, VAXDry heated towel rails and VAXRay industrial/outdoor heaters
- https://www.vaxmetal.com/en/industries/telescopic-masts — Portable telescopic antenna masts for UAV ground systems, RF/data links and deployable communications

## Working with VAXMetal
Send a drawing, STEP/DWG/DXF/PDF file, sketch, photo, sample or short specification. VAXMetal reviews manufacturability and prepares a production proposal based on geometry, materials, finishing, quantity and delivery requirements.

For sensitive defence or infrastructure projects, do not submit precise operational locations or other sensitive operational information through public website forms.
